label: sec:garside-gram-intro
html:
The light-nucleus normal forms of Derived Light-Atom Normal Forms exhibit a recurring staircase pattern of typed proton and neutron crossings. This section formalizes that pattern by defining the typed Garside element \Delta_{Z,N} of the nuclear braid and expressing the reaction \mathcal{Q}_q-value as a Gram-inverse weighted Frobenius norm over conversion channels.

At the Markov parameter z = q^3/(q^2+1), the Frobenius Gram matrix G on the full Hecke algebra H_n(q) has a non-trivial radical equal to the kernel of the Temperley–Lieb projection (y_{(1^3)} = 0), so the inverse-Gram weighting G^{-1} is evaluated on the non-degenerate quotient H_n(q)/\mathrm{rad}\,G \cong \mathrm{TL}_n(q). Proving that the Gram eigenstructure coincides with the adjoint character on the surviving Wedderburn blocks anchors the \mathcal{Q}_q-value in the Jucys–Murphy spectral data and prepares the transfer-matrix factorisation of Transfer Matrices and Beta-Decay Transitions.
